newsHighlights.title: Xi says ready to work with Trump to steer China-US ties on steady course
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping said he is ready to work with US President Donald Trump to steer the giant ship of China-US relationship on a steady course toward the future.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国国家主席习近平表示，愿同美国总统特朗普一道，引领中美关系这艘巨轮沿着稳定航道驶向未来。

newsHighlights.title: Xi attends welcome ceremony held by Trump
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi attended a welcome ceremony hosted by President Trump at the White House on Thursday morning during his state visit to the United States.
newsHighlights.translation: 周四上午，习近平主席在对美国进行国事访问期间，出席了特朗普总统在白宫举行的欢迎仪式。

newsHighlights.title: World leaders call for stronger AI safeguards at UN General Assembly
newsHighlights.summary: World leaders urged stronger safeguards for artificial intelligence at the UN General Assembly, calling for global dialogue and shared rules on emerging technologies.
newsHighlights.translation: 各国领导人在联合国大会上呼吁为人工智能建立更强有力的保障机制，主张就新兴技术展开全球对话并制定共同规则。

newsHighlights.title: FAST celebrates a decade of achievements
newsHighlights.summary: China's Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope, or FAST, has gained global recognition after a decade of work, and astronomers anticipate more breakthroughs ahead.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国500米口径球面射电望远镜（FAST）经过十年耕耘赢得国际认可，天文学家预期未来将取得更多突破。

quote.quote: The most important thing in communication is hearing what isn't said.
quote.author: Peter Drucker
quote.translation: 沟通中最重要的是听出那些没有被说出口的话。
quote.explanation: 管理学大师德鲁克提醒我们：真正的沟通不只是表达，更是倾听。在职场与外交场合，读懂言外之意、理解对方的真实关切，往往比滔滔不绝更有力量。

vocabulary.example: President Xi said he is ready to work with President Trump to steer the relationship on a steady course.
vocabulary.translation: 习主席表示愿与特朗普总统一道，引领两国关系沿着稳定航道前行。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道标题："Xi says ready to work with Trump to steer China-US ties on steady course"。

vocabulary.definition: 稳定的，平稳的；持续不变的
vocabulary.example: Both sides expressed the will to keep the giant ship of China-US relations on a steady course toward the future.
vocabulary.translation: 双方表达了让中美关系巨轮沿着稳定航道驶向未来的意愿。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻短语 "on a steady course toward the future"（沿着稳定航道驶向未来）。

vocabulary.example: President Xi attended a welcome ceremony held by President Trump at the White House.
vocabulary.translation: 习主席出席了特朗普总统在白宫举行的欢迎仪式。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道标题："Xi attends welcome ceremony held by Trump"。

vocabulary.example: The achievements made by FAST over the past decade have gained global recognition.
vocabulary.translation: FAST 过去十年取得的成就赢得了国际认可。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道："FAST celebrates a decade of achievements"。

vocabulary.definition: 保障措施，防护；保护，维护
vocabulary.example: World leaders called for stronger safeguards for artificial intelligence at the UN General Assembly.
vocabulary.translation: 各国领导人在联合国大会上呼吁为人工智能建立更强有力的保障机制。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 报道标题："World leaders call for stronger AI safeguards at UN General Assembly"。

vocabulary.example: Senior Chinese astronomers anticipate more breakthroughs in the years ahead.
vocabulary.translation: 中国资深天文学家预期未来几年将取得更多突破。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道 FAST 十周年成就："...who anticipate more breakthroughs"。

vocabulary.example: FAST's work has gained global recognition after ten years of observation.
vocabulary.translation: 经过十年观测，FAST 的成果获得了全球认可。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道："...have gained global recognition"。

vocabulary.example: The state visit is expected to strengthen bilateral communication between the two countries.
vocabulary.translation: 此次国事访问有望加强两国之间的双边沟通。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻中中美两国元首会晤与双边关系（China-US ties）的报道主题。

vocabulary.example: Delegates worked through the night to build a consensus on the new AI safeguards.
vocabulary.translation: 代表们彻夜努力，就新的人工智能保障措施达成共识。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联 CGTN 关于联合国大会各国领导人寻求共同 AI 规则的报道。

vocabulary.definition: 迎接，问候；（以某种方式）回应
vocabulary.example: President Xi landed in the US for a state visit and was greeted by President Trump at the airport.
vocabulary.translation: 习主席抵达美国进行国事访问，在机场受到特朗普总统迎接。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道标题："Xi lands in US for state visit, greeted by Trump at airport"。

pattern.pattern: be ready to do A to do B（准备好做A以实现B）
pattern.example: I am ready to work with President Trump to steer the giant ship of China-US relationship on a steady course toward the future.
pattern.translation: 我愿同特朗普总统一道，引领中美关系这艘巨轮沿着稳定航道驶向未来。
pattern.usage: 用于表达意愿与共同目标，语气正式而真诚。职场中可用于会议开场、合作洽谈或书面沟通："We are ready to work with your team to launch the project on schedule."（我们愿与贵团队合作，确保项目如期启动。）

grammar.title: 过去分词作状语（Past Participle as Adverbial）
grammar.explanation: 当句子的主语同时是某个被动动作的承受者时，可用「过去分词 + 其他成分」作状语，表示被动、完成或伴随状态，相当于一个省略的被动语态从句。新闻标题因篇幅有限经常使用这一结构，显得简洁有力。
examples: Xi lands in US for state visit, greeted by Trump at airport.（= ... and he was greeted by Trump at the airport.）
The achievements made by China's FAST have gained global recognition.（= The achievements that were made by China's FAST ...）

pronunciation.tips: 开头是清晰的 /s/ + /t/，注意 /t/ 不要发成中文的“特”；核心是双元音 /ɪə/，从 /ɪ/ 平滑滑向 /ə/，英音中词尾 r 不卷舌，只做轻微的 /ə/ 延伸。常见错误是把 steer 读成 /stiːl/ 或 /steə/。
examples: We must steer the project in the right direction.
Good leaders steer the team through difficult times.

reading.title: What a State Visit Teaches Us About Workplace Communication
reading.content: When Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in the United States on Thursday for a state visit, he was greeted at the airport by US President Donald Trump. At the White House welcome ceremony, President Xi said he is ready to work with President Trump to steer the giant ship of China-US relationship on a steady course toward the future. His words carry a useful lesson for anyone working in a modern office. Good results rarely come from one side alone. In the workplace, as in diplomacy, people need to listen carefully, speak clearly and build consensus step by step. A short, sincere remark at the right moment can open a door that a long report cannot. Whether you are leading a team or joining your first meeting, remember that communication is not about winning an argument. It is about steering everyone toward a shared goal.
reading.translation: 周四，中国国家主席习近平抵达美国进行国事访问，在机场受到美国总统特朗普的迎接。在白宫欢迎仪式上，习主席表示愿与特朗普总统一道，引领中美关系这艘巨轮沿着稳定航道驶向未来。他的话对任何在现代职场工作的人都有启发：好的结果很少来自单方面的努力。在职场中，正如在外交中一样，人们需要认真倾听、清晰表达，并一步步建立共识。一句简短而真诚的话，在恰当的时机，往往能打开一扇长篇报告也打不开的门。无论你是团队领导还是第一次参加会议的新人，请记住：沟通不是为了赢得争论，而是为了引领所有人朝着共同目标前进。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily 报道《Xi says ready to work with Trump to steer China-US ties on steady course》《Xi attends welcome ceremony held by Trump》《Xi lands in US for state visit, greeted by Trump at airport》改写，供英语学习使用。
